sloka: शीघ्रगस्य मरु: पुत्रो मरो: पुत्र: प्रशुश्रुक: ।प्रशुश्रुकस्य पुत्रो ऽभूदम्बरीषो महाद्युति: ॥ २.११०.२९॥
transliteration: śīghragasya maru: putro maro: putra: praśuśruka: ।praśuśrukasya putro 'bhūdambarīṣo mahādyuti: ॥ 2.110.29॥

translations.english: Shankhana was the famous son of Kalmashapada. Whoever challenged his prowess was routed with his entire army.
